records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue increased 7% for the three months ended March 31, 2024 compared to the corresponding period in the prior fiscal year, driven by a 51% increase in revenue in the B Medical Systems segment and a 4% increase in revenue in the Sample Management Solutions segment.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue decreased by 4% for the six months ended March 31, 2024 compared to the corresponding period in the prior fiscal year, driven by a 38% decrease in revenue in the B Medical Systems segment due to the timing of orders,

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In total, we employ approximately 3,400 full-time employees, part-time employees and contingent workers worldwide as of March 31, 2024 and have sales in approximately 150 countries.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was 40% for the three months ended March 31, 2024 compared to 36% for the corresponding period in the prior fiscal year, driven by margin expansion in all three business segments and higher revenue in the B Medical Systems and Sample Management Solutions segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating loss for the Sample Management Solutions segment was $3.0 million for the three months ended March 31, 2024 compared to an operating loss of $7.2 million in the corresponding period in the prior fiscal year.
